source.citation: A. Poglitsch and D. Weber, Dynamic disorder in methylammoniumtrihalogenoplumbates (II) observed by millimeter-wave spectroscopy, J. Chem. Phys. 87, 6373-6378 (1987)
source.how_verified: Web search and web pages only, 2026-11-03; nothing downloaded or executed. Primary: the publisher's landing page, reached from the DOI, confirms the title, authors, journal, volume 87, issue 11, pages 6373-6378 and the date (1 December 1987); its abstract says that the temperature-dependent crystal structures of CH3NH3PbX3 (X = Cl, Br, I) were determined by X-ray diffraction, but gives no lattice parameter, and the full text is offered as a PDF only, which was not read. Secondary: the Duke University Hybrid3 materials database, on its reference page for this paper, lists MAPbCl3 cubic Pm3m a = b = c = 5.675 A above 178.8 K (data set 166), tetragonal P4/mmm a = 5.656, c = 5.63 A between 172.9 and 178.8 K (167) and orthorhombic a = 5.673, b = 5.628, c = 11.182 A below 172.9 K (168), and for the same paper MAPbBr3 cubic 5.901 A and MAPbI3 cubic 6.3285 A; no uncertainty is given for the chloride. A search-result snippet of an RSC supplementary table (not opened) shows 5.675 A as the experimental cubic chloride value beside 5.901 A (Br) and 6.328 A (I). In the ideal cubic perovskite Pb-Cl = a/2.

rule: confirmed_2.837 iff the primary source is verified and a/2 equals 2.837 A at its stated digits; use_source_value iff the primary source is verified with another value (X-2: scripts/46 moves the shifted Cl to that distance and records start_override); provisional_2.837 otherwise (shifted starts at 2.837 A with --allow-provisional, labelled [M] starting points); a value read only in a secondary source does not verify (I-E1)
open_item: The secondary value a = 5.675 A gives a/2 = 2.8375 A, which differs from 2.837 A at the stated digits. If the primary text (the paper's structure table) is read before any shifted Cl start is built and states 5.675 A, the section 2 rule requires the shifted starts at 2.8375 A (decision use_source_value; X-2 start_override in scripts/46), recorded by rerunning scripts/52 pbcl with level '[S] primary verified'; if it states 5.674 A, 2.837 A is confirmed. Until then the shifted Cl starts are built at 2.837 A with --allow-provisional and labelled [M] starting points.
